holidays.name: National Piña Colada Day
holidays.description: A day to celebrate the creamy, tropical blend of rum, coconut cream, and pineapple juice. Pour one over ice, add a tiny paper umbrella, and pretend your cubicle is a beach.
holidays.origin: The drink is tied to Puerto Rico, which declared the piña colada its official drink in 1978. Bartenders Ramón Marrero and Ramón 'Monchito' Portas Mingot both claimed to have invented it in San Juan in the 1950s. Its July 10 date is an informal food-holiday designation, since Puerto Rico's own Piña Colada Day is July 10 as well.
holidays.funFact: The 1979 song 'Escape (The Piña Colada Song)' by Rupert Holmes was originally titled 'Escape' and had no mention of the drink in its title until people started calling it the piña colada song.

holidays.name: Teddy Bear Picnic Day
holidays.description: A day for grown-ups and kids alike to haul stuffed bears outside for sandwiches, juice boxes, and a little make-believe in the park.
holidays.origin: The holiday draws on the 1907 song 'The Teddy Bears' Picnic' by composer John Walter Bratton, with lyrics added by Jimmy Kennedy in 1932. The tune celebrates the idea that if you go into the woods today, you're sure of a big surprise.
holidays.funFact: The teddy bear is named after U.S. President Theodore 'Teddy' Roosevelt, who refused to shoot a tied-up bear on a 1902 hunting trip in Mississippi.

holidays.name: Don't Step on a Bee Day
holidays.description: A day dedicated to watching where you put your feet during summer so you don't accidentally harm a pollinator or earn yourself a painful sting. Flip-flops and bare feet in clover beware!
holidays.origin: This is an unofficial observance that grew out of summer safety and pollinator awareness campaigns. It encourages people to appreciate bees and avoid stepping on them in grass.
holidays.funFact: A honey bee can only sting once because its barbed stinger gets stuck in skin, and the bee usually dies afterward. Bumblebees can sting many times.

holidays.name: Kitten Day
holidays.description: A day to celebrate tiny, fluffy, pouncing balls of chaos and to boost awareness about kitten adoption. Think of it as a permission slip to watch kitten videos for hours.
holidays.origin: This is an informal pet-lover observance popularized online, especially around summer, which is peak kitten season at animal shelters.
holidays.funFact: Kittens sleep around 16 to 20 hours per day, and a group of kittens is called a kindle.

holidays.name: Pick Blueberries Day
holidays.description: A day for heading out to farms and bushes to pick fresh blueberries, eating roughly one for every two that make it into the basket.
holidays.origin: This is a seasonal agricultural food observance that falls during the peak of blueberry harvest in much of North America, encouraging people to enjoy local produce.
holidays.funFact: Blueberries are one of the few naturally blue foods, and their color comes from anthocyanin pigments in the skin, not the flesh. Their pale insides are actually greenish-white.
